name: Chopt
disclaimer_extra: Chopt's Spring 2026 guide prints every chopping, green, grain and protein at one standard portion, and states that its salads and bowls do NOT include dressing — so a menu item here needs a dressing added the same way a built one does. Dressings are published twice, at the 30 g salad pour and the 22 g bowl pour; the format chip picks which. Some items are marked select-locations-only.
blurb: Build a Chopt salad, bowl or wrap chopping by chopping — greens, core choppings, grains and beans, cheese, crunch, the goods, and every housemade dressing at its published pour.
